title: noccaea cornuticarpa
intro: Noccaea cornuticarpa, commonly known as the horned alpine cress, is a type of flowering plant in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is used in herbal medicine for its purported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Noccaea cornuticarpa are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of the plant include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and potential interactions.
